scope: LOCAL anvil chain from evm-contracts 550afc4 artifacts. Not a fork, live instance, UserOp, bundler or real quoter output.

statements: Zero initial bid: the pool starts with no native ETH. Until someone buys, selling the launch token fills nothing.
Buyer-funded quote reserve: the only native ETH in the pool is what buyers pay in. Sells can withdraw only that.

Permanent principal lock: of the total supply of 1000000000000000000000000000 raw units, 999999999999999999999999422 go into one position that nobody, including you, can withdraw, rebalance, migrate or refund, and the rounding remainder of 578 is minted to address(0), where nobody can ever spend it. Quote that buyers pay in is locked in the position too.

Creator fee: 5.0000% at trading start 2027-01-15T08:10:20.000Z, decaying with a fixed 600 s half-life rescaled to reach exactly 0.3000% after 3600 s, then 0.3000% for good. It is not linear: the excess over 0.3000% first falls to half or less 587 s after trading start. The fee is taken on the calculated side of every swap into a separate two-asset fee ledger, never into principal.

Launch ownership: 0x70997970c51812dc3a010c7d01b50e0d17dc79c8 (this account) becomes the launch owner. Only the current owner can claim the fee ledger, and ownership can be transferred. Whoever owns the launch when it claims receives every unclaimed fee, including fees earned before a transfer.

Owner recapture: every fee goes to the launch owner. When the owner, or anyone buying for it, trades, it gets that fee back through its claim: on an exact-input buy at 5.0000% it can end up with the whole pre-fee output, while anyone else making the same trade gets only the net. The fee cannot tell owners, snipers and honest buyers apart.

High early fee: near 5.0000%, a swap can deliver a negligible or zero amount after the fee, and an immediate round trip pays the fee twice plus price impact. A high starting fee is not protection against snipers and does not promise that anyone avoids a loss.

Exact-output gross-up: for a fixed output, the input paid is the pre-fee input times 1 / (1 - fee), about 1.05x at 5.0000%, which grows much faster than the fee itself. Large amounts at high fees revert on overflow. Always set a minimum output or a maximum input.
No exit guarantee: there is no buyer of last resort, no refund and no admin rescue. The price can fall back to the ask.

statements: Withdraws the whole two-asset fee ledger of this launch to 0x90f79bf6eb2c4f870365e785982e1f101e93b906, both assets or neither. It never touches the locked principal.
Only the current launch owner can claim. Ownership is transferable, so the right to claim follows the current owner, not the account that created the launch.
